### 1 — Scene
An Asian-style meal: three sushi pieces and a fresh rice-paper roll on a side plate, plus a bowl of golden tofu-like strips with vegetables and herbs. The glass appears to contain water and is excluded.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Side plate:** approximately 21 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10.5² ≈ **346 cm²**.
- **Shallow bowl:** approximately 20 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10² ≈ **314 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods are sushi with rice, nori and mixed filling; a filled rice-paper roll; golden strips that appear to be fried tofu; shredded cabbage and sliced vegetables; fresh herbs; and a little dressing. The strip and filling identities are uncertain.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Coverage percentages are relative to each food’s own vessel. Heights are average pile heights; bulk density is applied only once.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × height = gross volume | Density → weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|
| Three sushi pieces | 15% of plate | 52 × 1.8 = 94 ml | 0.95 → **89 g** | 155 | 138 kcal |
| Rice-paper roll | 23% of plate | 80 × 1.8 = 144 ml | 0.95 → **137 g** | 125 | 171 kcal |
| Fried tofu-like strips | 30% of bowl | 94 × 1.4 = 132 ml | 0.9 → **119 g** | 250 | 298 kcal |
| Cabbage and sliced vegetables | 22% of bowl | 69 × 1.6 = 110 ml | 0.55 → **61 g** | 30 | 18 kcal |
| Fresh herbs | 5% of bowl | 16 × 1.5 = 24 ml | 0.15 → **4 g** | 25 | 1 kcal |
| Visible dressing | 3% of bowl | 9 × 0.4 = 4 ml | 1.0 → **4 g** | 200 | 8 kcal |

**Coverage check:** approximately **38% of the plate** and **60% of the bowl**, consistent with their substantial empty rims. Dressing coverage represents the visible pooled/coated portion rather than additional coverage beneath other items.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **414 g of food and approximately 634 kcal**. This is plausible for three sushi pieces, one substantial fresh roll and a modest bowl of tofu and vegetables. The largest energy uncertainty is whether the golden strips are fried tofu or another protein.
